answer: Challenge-Embedded Task Registry. Each task carries a random seed that reshapes a public trellis of subgoals, so every answer is valid only for that seed and cannot be reused elsewhere. Replay is rejected because the verifier checks the solution against the current horizon of subgoals, not a fixed answer. To farm rewards, an attacker must solve each instance fresh, paying full compute per identity. The required work grows along a spiral of increasing difficulty, so marginal sybil accounts cost more than they earn.
